articles.headline: Ukraine to receive $841 million from World Bank amid budget deficit
articles.excerpt: The funding will be used to reimburse pension payments from the state budget.

articles.headline: BREAKING: Trump claims Ukraine, Russia agree to halt strikes on energy targets, Kyiv unaware of deal
articles.excerpt: "Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy Targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise!" Trump said in a Truth Social post on Sept. 14.

articles.headline: Drone strikes near Polish border show Putin's 'desperation,' NATO's Rutte says
articles.excerpt: Polish Interior Minister Marcin Kierwinski said Poland was treating the incident with the "utmost seriousness."

articles.headline: Zelensky to push energy, Black Sea ceasefire at possible Trump meeting in New York
articles.excerpt: "We are open to a maritime ceasefire, as well as an energy ceasefire," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

articles.headline: Russian general involved in Donetsk offensives reportedly killed in Ukrainian strike
articles.excerpt: The reported death has been linked to a Ukrainian strike on Aug. 26 against Russian command posts in occupied Donetsk.
